overview: SmileCare Clinic Platform is a full-stack hybrid SaaS clinic management system featuring a premium public-facing medical website for SmileCare Clinic (Kolkata) and a comprehensive admin panel. Patients can browse doctors, book appointments through a guided multi-step flow, and manage their health records via a personal portal. Clinic staff get a powerful dashboard to manage appointments, doctors, patients, and payments — all with a professional deep teal and gold medical aesthetic.
features: Public clinic website with Home, About, Departments, Doctors, Contact, and Reviews pages
7-step appointment booking flow with doctor selection, date/time window, OTP login, patient details, UPI payment, coupon code, and confirmation
Patient portal with appointment tracking, medical record uploads, and profile management
Admin dashboard with live stats, appointment approval workflow, and activity feed
Doctor management with add/edit/delete, weekly schedule, and department assignment
Patient records search with appointment history and uploaded document list
Payment management with manual status update and UPI ID settings
Multi-language support: English, Hindi, Bengali toggle for public website
Pre-loaded demo data: SmileCare Clinic, 3 doctors, 3 departments, sample appointments and reviews
Mobile-first responsive design with deep teal primary and warm gold accents
